answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 33982 Country: India Title: Wearing Pant or Pajama Question: I am wearing my paint, pajama above ankle so my non-Muslim friend asked me that "What is the reason to wear paint, pajama above ankle?" Please send me answer for this as soon as possible. Answer ID: 33982 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1503/1231/B=1432) It is the sign of arrogance to wear pant and pyjama below the ankles. Almighty Allah does not like the arrogant and their manners. Also it is mentioned in hadith that on the Day of Resurrection, Allah will not look at a person who trails his lower garment below ankle in arrogance. It is also mentioned in another hadith that such person shall go in Hell. On this ground, a Muslim should always wear lungi or pyjama above the ankles. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
